_comment: .vscode/mcp.json — VS Code MCP configuration for labs-repo.
What:   wires (a) the built-in GitHub MCP server, (b) the bosch-canlog
server, and (c) the mock-analyzer into Copilot agent mode. Both
local servers live IN THIS REPO under mcp/ — see
mcp/mcp-servers.json (the harness-neutral master copy; keep the
Used by: Session 3 · Activity 3-A (github block) and Lab 3-B
Run:    VS Code discovers .vscode/mcp.json automatically (MCP is GA in
VS Code since Jul 2025). Requires the org policy 'MCP servers in
Copilot' to be ENABLED — it is disabled by default.
Note:   no secrets in this file, ever. Secrets arrive via 'inputs' prompts
(stored in secret storage) or environment variables. JSON has no
comments — remove this _comment key in your working copy.
Python: server commands use 'python' (not python3) so they work on Windows/Git Bash;
on Linux/macOS 'python' must resolve to Python 3 (Ubuntu: sudo apt install python-is-python3).
